name: pdf
description: PDF reader: renders pages in the viewer (hayro rasterizer in wasm) and answers questions about documents from deterministic extracted text (assets/tools.wasm pdf_digest). Requests FULL filesystem read access so it can open PDFs on any mount.

command_hooks.description: Shell /open routes .pdf through this agent: the page is rasterized (hayro in wasm) into the pdf viewer tab; /pdf text gets the extracted text instead.
